description: This file defines the Merger class for synchronizing items, content, and attachments in the Notesnook project, along with functions for conflict detection and inbox item handling.

classes.name: Merger
classes.description: Class responsible for merging remote and local items, handling conflicts, and attachment synchronization.

methods.name: mergeItem
methods.description: Merges a remote item with a local item, updating or replacing based on modification dates and specific conditions.

methods.name: mergeContent
methods.description: Merges content items, handling conflicts and data differences, and marking conflicts when necessary.

methods.name: mergeAttachment
methods.description: Handles merging of attachment items, resolving conflicts by deleting local files if needed.
